messages:
Alex K: Quick follow-up from the postmortem 
- we need owners/timelines for the rollout guardrail items. Main buckets: auto-rollback thresholds, blast-radius limits, and recurrence detection.
Maria P: I can own auto-rollback tuning. Will propose concrete thresholds and a small canary test plan by EOD Thu.
Jon S: I'll take blast-radius controls (flag scoping + saturation limits). ETA next Tue.
Irene C: I'll draft recurrence-detection pulse: grouping by feature flag, error signature, and model version. Aim to onboard into detection pipeline in 2 sprints.
Taylor R: Can someone paste the link to the postmortem for context?
Alex K: Postmortem: https://redwood.company/postmortems/2026-03-22-service-degradation 
See section 4 for telemetry gaps.
Maria P: Notes: current auto-rollback is purely 5xx-rate > 2% across prod. We should make it multi-signal and windowed (latency p95, user-facing error, and ramp rate).
Jon S: Also limit blast radius by scoping flags to 5% for first 10k users, then 25%, then 100% with guard timers. Add an emergency quarantine switch that's global with 30s TTL.
Irene C: Recurrence rules: if same flag+model combo causes > 3 incidents in 90d, auto-open a remediation epic and tag owning team. Surface to weekly reliability review.
Maria P: Draft rollback policy sketch (pasted inline):
```
feature_flag: new_vector_routing
stages:
  - pct: 1
    duration: 1h
    metrics: [p95_latency, user_errors]
  - pct: 10
    duration: 6h
rollback:
  - if: "p95_latency > 200ms and user_errors_rate > 1%"
    window: 10m
    action: rollback_to: stable
    notify: [eng-oncall, product-owner]
```
Jon S: Add saturation cap: max concurrent users per rollout bucket = 5000 to prevent accidental 100% pushes from misconfigured jobs.
Taylor R: Need runbook steps for oncall: validate metric signal, execute rollback, confirm recovery. Can someone make a 1-page checklist?
Alex K: Action: @Taylor R to produce 1-page playbook checklist by Mon.
Taylor R: On it.
Maria P: Action items from me: 1) Auto-rollback multi-signal proposal (owner: Maria, due: Thu EOD). 2) Canary test plan with sample traffic (Maria + Jon, due: next Tue).
Jon S: My actions: 1) Blast-radius flag scoping + saturation cap implementation (owner: Jon, due: next Tue). 2) Quarantine global switch with 30s TTL (owner: Jon, due: next Wed).
Irene C: My actions: 1) Recurrence detection rules + alerting (owner: Irene, due: sprint end). 2) Auto-open remediation epic flow (owner: Irene, due: sprint end).
Alex K: I'll track these in the postmortem follow-ups board and add owners to the cross-team tracking card.
Taylor R: Suggest adding a synthetic test that runs on canary traffic every 5m to detect regressions earlier using existing canary harness.
Maria P: I'll add a placeholder synthetic test and metrics.
Jon S: Constraint: infra review required for global switches. I'll loop in infra when spec is ready.
Alex K: @deploy-bot set a reminder: follow-up sync in 7 days.
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled by Alex K: "Rollout guardrails follow-up sync" in 7 days.
Taylor R: Also add an A/B of thresholds: conservative vs aggressive for 2 weeks, measure false positives, auto-revert after 24h if too many false positives.
Irene C: For recurrence detection, I'll prototype a small clustering notebook to group noisy errors vs true regressions and share results.
Maria P: Please add owners' GitHub handles to the tracking card for PR notifications.
Alex K: Will do. Closing note: prioritize safety over velocity for the next month while these changes land. :+1:
